sub_parameters.name: MappedName
sub_parameters.description: The mapped name of the database.

sub_parameters.name: SpecificTables
sub_parameters.description: A collection of configurations for specific table objects. When `mode` is `WILDCARD`, this parameter specifies the renaming and row filtering configurations for specific table objects.

sub_parameters.name: SpecificViews
sub_parameters.description: A list of configurations for specific view objects. When `mode` is `WILDCARD`, this parameter specifies the renaming configuration for specific view objects.

sub_parameters.name: Tables
sub_parameters.description: The configuration for transferring table objects in the current database. When Mode is set to WILDCARD, this parameter specifies the blacklist or whitelist configuration, which is shared by tables and views.

sub_parameters.name: Views
sub_parameters.description: A list of configurations for transferring view objects in the current database.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task.

parameters.name: TransferMapping
parameters.description: The list of transfer objects. This is required when you modify matching rules.
